source.author: lucan
source.text: Verba ducis nullo partes clamore sequuntur, Nec matura petunt promissae classica pugnae.
source.text_original: Verba ducis nullo partes clamore sequuntur, / Nec matura petunt promissae classica pugnae.
source.text_english: The men follow the leader’s words with no shouting, nor do they eagerly seek the bugles of the promised battle before their time.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: oritur clamor dextraeque sequuntur verba ducis.
reuse.text_original: oritur clamor dextraeque sequuntur / verba ducis.
reuse.text_english: A shout arises, and the right hands follow the leader’s words.
